description: List the diagram languages this server can render (Mermaid, PlantUML, C4-PlantUML, Graphviz, D2, Structurizr, BPMN, Excalidraw), with each one's aliases, supported outputs (svg, png), syntax docs link and a minimal valid example. name: list_formats
